cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

mechanism: A claims expert responsibility for approvals and corrects calendar status to make verification appear an unnecessary duplicate.
confusable: D62 evades origin of authority; D66 asserts authorisation as completed procedure and discourages a confirming check.
comparison: Inspection alternative threatens recorded delay; rehearsal alternative presents verification as workflow duplication.
seedUse: Room request, A own stamp, hold and confirmed status derive from D66-b; S03 adds role and field corrections.
